description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
